summary: Final navigation fix on the parent configuration question: its discriminator no longer asks which requests an empty or stale configuration admits, since three child questions now measure that with their own receipts (vote and pre-vote admission, leadership acceptance and entry dispatch, stale-configuration commit quorum, and refusal of an eligible voter). It now names what genuinely remains open in that account — whether an installed snapshot, rather than an arriving configuration entry, restores the recovered configuration at runtime, and whether a legal history exists where the node stays inside the configuration in force while its log is far enough behind to receive one. No evidence, comparison or conclusion changed.
